overview: Hyderabad is the capital and biggest city of the South Indian territory of Telangana. It was administered by the Qutub Shahis, Mughals, and the Nizams which molded its history. The city is noted for its landmarks which incorporate the work of art of Charminar and the stronghold of Golconda. There are a huge number of masjids, sanctuaries, houses of worship and bazaars in the city.

The travel industry shapes a significant job in the economy of Hyderabad. The travel industry related fairs are held regularly,and in 2010, the city was recorded among the Beta-World City by the worldwide city file created by GaWC,and in 2011 the city was evaluated nineteenth on the planet by The New York Times in The rundown of 41 Places to Go in 2011. It was positioned third Best City to Travel in 2013 by Lonely Planet. Starting at 2011, The travel industry advancement financial plan for the city was expanded to ₹520 million. Telangana, which is India's top residential traveler goal, gets up to 157 million visits,and arrived at 1.5 million global sightseers, which created US$23 million in income. The city houses popular recorded destinations including Charminar, UNESCO Asia Pacific Heritage site of the Chowmahalla Palace, Salar Jung Museum (among the world's biggest private assortment historical centers) just as craftsmanship exhibitions, libraries, sports buildings, galleries and theaters.It is the spot of nawabs.

days.title: Hyderabad
days.body:
After breakfast visit Sudha Car Museum . Post lunch Salarjung Museum ) and then shop for some mementoes. Evening Drive through Hussain Sagar (See World’s Biggest One Piece Buddha Statue in the midst of the lake), Necklace Road and visit Lumbini Park & Laser Show (Country’s best laserium show). Dinner & overnight stay at the hotel

days.title: Hyderabad
days.body:
Post breakfast visit Nehru Zoological Park, Snow World, Charminar and Mecca Masjid. It is made out of single slabs of granite brought from a stone quarry, 11 km north of Charminar & pulled by 1400 bullocks etc. Return to the hotel. Dinner and overnight stay.
Meal : Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner
